title: Virtual Zoo
hints: To call `swim()` only on animals that can, ask: `if (auto* s{ dynamic_cast<ISwimmer*>(animal.get()) }) s->swim();` (lesson 8.06).
The destructor in `Animal` must be `virtual`, otherwise deleting a `Penguin` through an `Animal` pointer skips the `Penguin` part. Take the `virtual` away once and look at which messages go missing.
requirements: An `Animal` hierarchy at least three levels deep, for example `Animal → Bird → Penguin`
Virtual `speak()` and `move()`; the penguin overrides `move()` to swim
One interface mixed in, such as `ISwimmer` with a pure virtual `swim()`
Destructors that print, proving every animal is cleaned up
